name: proof-of-remittance
description: Prove an INR bank credit cleared a threshold from the bank's own HTTPS response (TLSNotary + Noir), without revealing the amount, then release a USDC escrow on-chain.
author: Agnij Dutta (https://github.com/agnij-dutta)

scripts.build: npm run certs && npm run build:rust && npm run build:circuit && npm run build:contracts
scripts.build:circuit: cd circuit && nargo compile && bb write_vk -b target/remittance.json -o target -t evm
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust && npm run test:circuit && npm run test:contracts
scripts.lint: biome check . && tsc -p . && cargo fmt --manifest-path prover-rs/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --release --locked --all-targets --manifest-path prover-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cd contracts && forge fmt --check && cd ../circuit && nargo fmt --check
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path prover-rs/Cargo.toml && cd contracts && forge fmt && cd ../circuit && nargo fmt
scripts.check:verifier: bb write_solidity_verifier -k circuit/target/vk -o .run/HonkVerifier.check.sol -t evm && cmp .run/HonkVerifier.check.sol contracts/src/HonkVerifier.sol
